turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on there is and there are?
turns.tutor:
Here is the rule: say there is for one thing and there are for two or more.
Right: "There are four ducks on the lake."
Wrong: "There is four ducks on the lake." There are four ducks, more than one, so there is does not fit.
I think aloud with my example: "There is a frog in the pond."
Step 1: How many frogs? One.
Step 2: One thing takes there is.
Now your turn. Complete:
"___ three windows in my room."
